hook: HC won't delay *TGPSC AEE* exams on Nov *6-7*
hook_b: Clash with SSC-JE? TGPSC AEE stays on Nov *6-7*
tldr: The Telangana High Court refused to postpone the TGPSC Assistant Executive Engineer exams despite a clash with SSC Junior Engineer papers.

beats.what: The TGPSC AEE exams are scheduled for November 6 and 7. Candidates had cited a clash with SSC JE exams.
beats.why: The court did not defer the exams, so the dates stand.
beats.care: Candidates with both exams must plan for the TGPSC dates. Check your hall ticket and centre now.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today reports the High Court refused to defer the Nov 6-7 AEE exams. The court's full reasoning was not in the summary.

cards.q: On which dates are the TGPSC AEE exams?
cards.why: The High Court refused to defer the Nov 6-7 exams.

learn.t: AEE stands for Assistant Executive Engineer, a senior engineering post in state departments.

watch: TGPSC notices for any change to centres or timings.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana HC refuses to defer TGPSC AEE exams over SSC-JE schedule clash
